Kalshalyst v1.0.0 — Initial release of the contrarian prediction market scanner.

- Scans Kalshi markets for mispricings using a five-phase pipeline: fetch, classify, estimate contrarian probability, calculate edge, and alert.
- Employs Claude Sonnet in contrarian mode to deliver directional calls with explanations and confidence.
- Calculates Brier scores to track estimation accuracy over time and uses the Kelly Criterion for optimal position sizing.
- Implements robust market filtering by volume, timeframe, and category to identify the most tradeable opportunities.
- Alerts users to high-edge opportunities and maintains a cache and calibration log for monitoring signal trustworthiness.
- Integrates seamlessly with the OpenClaw ecosystem, supporting Market Morning Brief and Kalshi Command Center.
